description: Use this when the host asks what one of their interviews contains or how it is set up, or before changing it with update_interview. Do not use it for meetings held on another service, for another account's interviews, to list interviews (use list_interviews) or to read what participants said (use get_results). It returns one interview in full: its title, purpose, mode (audio or video), language, version, questions, result fields, first and closing messages, whether it is paused, for a video interview whether its integrity signals are on, and whether the warm-up is on. Its complete lists provide the current setup for update_interview.

interview_id.description: The interview's id, exactly as list_interviews or create_interview returned it in its structured data. It is for tool calls only: never show it to the host; name the interview by its title. Do not guess an id, and do not send a title or an email address in its place: if you do not have the id, call list_interviews.
